# aj field

List fields and manage custom fields.


## `aj field list`

List fields, with the ids to use in --field, --fields and JQL.

```text
aj field list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-c`, `--custom` |  | Only custom fields. |
| `-q`, `--query` `TEXT` |  | Name or id contains. |
| `--trashed` |  | Custom fields in the trash. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj field create`

Create a custom field.

```text
aj field create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` `TEXT` | required | Field name. |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` | required | text, textarea, number, select, multiselect, checkbox, radio, date, datetime, url, labels, user, multiuser, group, or a full Jira type key. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--searcher` `TEXT` |  | Searcher key (default fits the type). |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj field update`

Rename a custom field or change its description or searcher.

```text
aj field update FIELD_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FIELD_ID` | required | Custom field id, e.g. customfield_10042. |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | New name. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--searcher` `TEXT` |  | New searcher key. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `aj field delete`

Move a custom field to the trash (restorable for 60 days).

```text
aj field delete FIELD_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FIELD_ID` | required | Custom field id, e.g. customfield_10042. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `aj field restore`

Restore a custom field from the trash.

```text
aj field restore FIELD_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FIELD_ID` | required | Custom field id, e.g. customfield_10042. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
